issue_records.title: Fix parsing of `-1::Int` - signed literals with type assertions
issue_records.body_excerpt: This syntax is normally not something you'd use, but it's very useful for `ccall`. Previously the parser just crashed on this kind of input - a bug which is also present in the old parser.
